name: mcbrain
description: Build and operate McBrain — a persistent, LLM-maintained personal knowledge base based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Hybrid lexical+semantic search runs through a shared local mcbrain-engine MCP server installed once per machine, so McBrain works in both Claude Code and Claude Cowork (Desktop). Bundles cooperating skills for one-shot vault setup, day-to-day operations (ingest/query/lint/synth), and either local- or Notion-backed research trackers — each with a creator skill and a queue runner that drains research tasks and writes findings back into the vault.
